meta.profile_title: Spinning Cat Loaf – Separately Printed Eyes Version
meta.profile_notes: Print Profile: Spinning Cat Loaf – Separately Printed Eyes Version Profile Description This print profile is for the Spinning Cat Loaf model with the eyes printed as separate parts . The cat body, internal spinning components, and eyes are printed individually to improve surface quality and simplify assembly. The cat body is printed at a standard layer height for smooth exterior surfaces. The internal spinning components use a balanced layer height to maintain proper fit and reliable rotation. The eyes are printed at a finer layer height to preserve detail before being attached during assembly. A small brim is included on select components to improve bed adhesion and stability during printing. The upper spinning component includes supports where needed to ensure consistent geometry. Print Settings Cat Body Layer Height: 0.20 mm Supports: None Orientation: As provided Internal Spinning Components Layer Height: 0.16 mm Supports: Enabled for the top spinning component Brim: Small brim enabled on applicable parts Orientation: As provided Eyes Layer Height: 0.12 mm Supports: None Orientation: Flat on the bed Assembly Notes The eyes are designed to be glued into place after printing. A small amount of CA glue or similar adhesive is sufficient. Ensure the spinning components are free of debris before final assembly to allow smooth rotation. Eyes have 4 total filament changes when adhering to included profile settings. Notes This profile has been tested for fit and function using the listed settings. Profile photos show printed parts and the assembled model using this configuration. Parts are arranged on separate plates for clarity and ease of printing.
